hosted.name: world10-retained-hosted09.json
hosted.interpretation: These exact retained hosted phase intervals support construction and early synthesis/renderer costs. GC overlap and coarse CPU readings do not establish OS scheduling or JIT causation.

baseline.scope: 118 original authored MJS source/profiler/fixture files only; no CodeWalker upstream source or binaries

interpretation.contention: Four separate bounded CPU workers maximum; ready handshake before measurement, bounded self lifetime and parent termination, explicit stop and joined close. Partial-core contention, not GTA load or an OS scheduling trace.
interpretation.cold: Fresh process with no synthetic warm history on real bank; cold prefix and later blocks share one genuine source lifecycle.
interpretation.sourcePreparation: Immutable bank preparation and authored throwaway JIT work are outside timed render; neither starts the audible vehicle.
interpretation.scheduler: CPU counters, GC overlap, V8 sampled stacks, dispatch delay and event-loop delay remain distinct observations. No OS descheduling cause established.

limits.preparation: Immutable source data and authored JIT startup work run before rendering on the same Node thread. This is not worker CPU isolation and does not fabricate genuine source history.
limits.scheduling: Partial-core bounded process contention, V8 sample clock bounds, process/thread counters, GC overlap and callback dispatch are distinct observations. No independent OS scheduler trace.
limits.generalisation: Short original authored fixtures do not qualify private bank sizes, real game load, WASAPI continuity, audibility or long-session real-time safety.
